footer.intro: Relaxed hoodies and caps with the NOV skyline embroidery — four colours, made for every day.

about.title: A hoodie with a message.
about.lead: NOV started with one idea: everyday pieces that carry a meaning, not just a logo.
about.p1: Every Skyline Hoodie carries the same three lines down the sleeve — Go in peace, Move in trust, Act in faith. A reminder you wear every day.
about.p2: On the back, a detailed skyline of towers, Tower Bridge and Big Ben, with NOV beneath it; on the chest, a smaller version of the same design. Four colours, one signature.

values.d: The sleeve line is part of every piece — words to carry with you.
Skyline embroidery, sleeve lettering and a QR code at the cuff.
A relaxed fit in soft, heavyweight fabric, made to be worn daily.

about.imageAlt: The back of the black NOV hoodie with the skyline embroidery

contact.title: How can we help?
contact.lead: Questions about sizes, your order or delivery? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.
contact.shippingBody: We deliver across Qatar in 2–4 working days. Delivery is free on orders over QAR 400, otherwise QAR 25. Unworn pieces can be returned within 14 days.

faq.a: The Skyline Hoodie has a relaxed fit. If you prefer it closer to the body, go one size down.
Wash cold and inside out, then lay flat to dry — the embroidery and fabric stay looking new.
You pay on delivery, in cash or by card.
Yes — contact us within 12 hours of placing it.
